2608.08056.title: H2: A Dual Hybrid Semantic Data Lake Architecture for Medical Data Harmonization with Human-In-the-Loop verified, LLM Driven Metadata Annotation System
2608.08056.paper_summary: Medical data, by its nature, exhibit a high degree of heterogeneity on multiple levels ranging from (a) different modalities like images, text and time series, (b) diverse tabular schemata introduced by institutions and (c) completely unstructured textual information data provided by healthcare professionals. Data lakes are often used in medical data storage to consolidate all heterogeneous diverse data in a single, central location, where it can be saved "as is", without the need to impose a schema like a data warehouse does. Despite their flexibility, though, data lakes are notorious for the "data swamp" failure. Thus, providing a reliable data harmonization mechanism through metadata, without compromising integrity or flexibility, is a real challenge. To this end, knowledge graphs have attracted attention since they provide a dynamic way to depict relationships without a rigid schema-on-write approach. Additionally, another rigorous task relies on the interoperability of data: application of appropriate ML techniques on such a diverse nature of data is not an easy task, as a domain expert must decide the efficacy of a method to a specific data type or dataset. Metadata annotation can aid by tagging applicable operations, however this requires manual intervention, not to mention the plethora of existing datasets which lack such information. To tackle both challenges, in this paper, we propose a semantic data lake architecture that promotes data harmonization and incorporates a generative annotation process (i.e. LLMs) of non-labeled metadata collections to support the application of meaningful ML techniques. Building on top of this approach, we create a higher level of knowledge, identifying suitability of data with respect to applicable ML operations based on their data nature...
2608.08056.paper_summary_zh: 醫療數據本質上在多個層面上展現出高度的異質性，這些層面包括 (a) 不同的模態，如影像、文本和時間序列，(b) 各機構引入的多樣化表格架構，以及 (c) 由醫療專業人員提供的完全非結構化的文本信息數據。數據湖常用於醫療數據存儲，以將所有異質的多樣數據集中在一個中央位置，在這裡可以“原樣”保存，而無需像數據倉庫那樣強加架構。儘管數據湖具有靈活性，但卻因“數據沼澤”失敗而臭名昭著。因此，通過元數據提供可靠的數據協調機制，而不損害完整性或靈活性，是一個真正的挑戰。為此，知識圖譜引起了關注，因為它們提供了一種動態的方式來描繪關係，而不需要僵化的寫入架構。此外，另一項嚴格的任務依賴於數據的互操作性：在如此多樣的數據性質上應用適當的機器學習技術並不是一件容易的事，因為領域專家必須決定某種方法對特定數據類型或數據集的有效性。元數據註釋可以通過標記適用的操作來提供幫助，然而這需要手動干預，更不用說現有的眾多數據集缺乏這種信息。為了解決這兩個挑戰，在本文中，我們提出了一種語義數據湖架構，促進數據協調並結合非標記元數據集合的生成註釋過程（即大型語言模型）以支持有意義的機器學習技術的應用。在這種方法的基礎上，我們創造了一個更高層次的知識，根據數據的性質識別數據與適用的機器學習操作的適用性。
